description: Use when you need a health and content snapshot of your own website: HTTP status, final URL, TLS, server, robots.txt and sitemap, plus WordPress REST. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /site/snapshot, $0.005 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. For DNS, SPF, DMARC and registration use domain_report; to check a site together with an IP, CVE or package use check_infra. With an access key (Authorization: Bearer p0k_..., buy at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) the tool pays the call itself, returns the data and deducts the price. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

url.description: Root of your own https site, e.g. https://example.com/ (host name only, no path)
